arguments.command:
cd /workspace && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import sys, json, re, copy
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev')
import harness; harness.setup_env()
base = {'capacity': {'range': 1, 'exact': 1},
        'releases': [{'id': 'm', 'classes': 1, 'width': 2, 'eps': [1, 1], 'ratio': [0, 1],
                      'threshold': [1, 1], 'mode': 'range', 'packet_limit': 2, 'idle_us': 0,
                      'discovery': [], 'train': [{'class': 0, 'values': [1, 2]}],
                      'validation': [{'class': 0, 'values': [1, 2]}]}],
        'blocks': []}
text = json.dumps(base)
def probe(name, data, invalid):
    out = harness.answer(data if isinstance(data, bytes) else json.dumps(data).encode())
    bad = out.get('error') == 'invalid_request'
    print(('OK  ' if bad == invalid else 'PROBLEM ') + name + (' rejected' if bad else ' accepted'))
    return bad == invalid
ok = True
def mutate(**kw):
    item = copy.deepcopy(base)
    if 'op_id' in kw:
        item['blocks'] = [['open', kw['op_id']], ['close', kw['op_id']]]
    if 'blocks' in kw:
        item['blocks'] = kw['blocks']
    if 'validation' in kw:
        item['releases'][0]['validation'] = kw['validation']
    return item
ok &= probe('bad flow id', mutate(op_id='a b'), True)
ok &= probe('long flow id', mutate(op_id='x' * 33), True)
ok &= probe('open without install', mutate(op_id='f'), True)
ok &= probe('20001 blocks', mutate(blocks=[[['install', 'm']]] + [[]] * 20000), True)
ok &= probe('20000 blocks', mutate(blocks=[[]] * 20000), False)
ok &= probe('validation rows 4097', mutate(validation=[{'class': 0, 'values': [1, 2]}] * 4097), True)
ok &= probe('validation values over budget',
            mutate(validation=[{'class': 0, 'values': [1] * 128} for _ in range(8192)]), True)
ok &= probe('root null', None, True)
ok &= probe('root number', 5, True)
bad = json.loads(text); bad['releases'] = ['x']
ok &= probe('release string', bad, True)
ok &= probe('bom', b'\xef\xbb\xbf' + text.encode(), True)
ok &= probe('capacity float', text.replace('"range":1', '"range":1.0').encode(), True)
ok &= probe('activation float', text.replace('"values":[1,2]', '"values":[1,2.5]').encode(), True)
ok &= probe('string id numeric', text.replace('"id":"m"', '"id":5').encode(), True)
ok &= probe('baseline valid', json.loads(text), False)
print('ALL', ok)
PYEOF
